Hon'ble Rajeev Misra,J.
(Order on Correction Application) Heard Mr. Sanjeev Kumar Shukla, the learned counsel for applicant and the learned A.G.A. for State.
This correction application has been filed by applicant seeking correction in the order dated 17.03.2023.

Learned counsel for applicant submits that in the 1st paragraph of the order dated 17.03.2023, the name of the counsel for applicant has wrongly been transcribed as "Sanjay Kumar Shukla" whereas the correct description is "Sanjeev Kumar Shukla"
He, therefore, submits that aforesaid mistakes occurring in the order dated 17.03.2023 be corrected accordingly.

It is then contended by the learned counsel for applicant that the last paragraph of the order dated 17.03.2023 to the following effect - The impugned Summoning Order dated 02.04.2022 passed by Shri Ram vs State Of U.P. sentences.text: He, therefore sumbits that aforesaid mistake occurring in the order dated 17.03.2023 be also corrected accordingly.
Prayer made by the learned counsel for applicant is bona-fide.

Accordingly it is allowed.
It is thus provided that in the 1st paragraph of the order dated 17.03.2023, in place of the description "Sanjay Kumar Shukla", the description "Sanjeev Kumar Shukla" shall be read.

Similarly, in the last paragraph of the order dated 17.03.2023 shall now be substituted by the following - "The impugned Summoning Order dated 14.06.2022 passed by Judicial Magistrate,
Azamgarh in Complaint Case No. 4612 of 2019 (Shri Narain Vs. Shri Ram), under Sections 406,
420, 506 IPC, Police Station-Pavai, District-Azamgarh, is set aside.

The Judicial Magistrate,
Azamgarh shall pass a fresh order in the light of the observations made herein above"
Accordingly, the present application succeeds and is allowed.
This correction shall from part of the earlier order dated 17.03.2023.
With the aforesaid directions, this correction application stands finally disposed off.
